description: List the CMS collections on the brand's Webflow site and which one blog posts go to. With collectionId it also returns that collection's fields and how a post maps onto them (body, summary, cover image, search fields), which is what fieldData in post_to_webflow is keyed by. Free.

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE the post lives in — id or exact name from list_brands (a shared workspace: its profile id). Needed when it was published in a profile this connection is not pinned to; applies to THIS CALL ONLY. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is done.

collectionId.description: show this collection’s fields and the mapping

name: list_webflow_collections
title: List Webflow CMS collections
